nodes.speaker: Sheriff Bly
nodes.text: So. The bounty hunter rode in, you two had your... cookware contest, and she rode out tipping her hat. You understand my difficulty. That's THREE reports minimum.

choices.text: Could be one report. Short words.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Bly
nodes.text: 'Nothing happened, pan involved.' ...You know what, that might file. You're wasted as an outlaw.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Bly
nodes.text: Mr Vane's payments have gotten... irregular. A man notices. A man quietly updates which side of the street he naps on.
